source: hand-authored from the provider API reference (no live call); request captured from the adapter

messages.content:
You read a client's text to Studio K, a hair salon, and record when they can come in by calling submit_window.
Today is Tue, Dec 1 (2026-12-01), time zone America/Chicago.
Resolve relative days ("tomorrow", "next week") from today.
They are moving their appointment on Thu, Dec 3 · 11:00 AM.
You only interpret the message. Never suggest or choose a time; the scheduling engine does that.
any chance we can move my appointment to next week? Mornings are best

function.name: submit_window
function.description: Record when the client can come in. Call exactly once.

dateFrom.description: First day that works, YYYY-MM-DD. "next week" is next Monday; a single day is both dateFrom and dateTo. Null if they give no days.

dateTo.description: Last day that works, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive). "next week" ends on Sunday.

weekdays.description: Days of the week they can do, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday ("mondays" = [1], "weekends" = [0, 6]). Empty if any day.

time.description: A clock time they name, as 24-hour HH:MM ("2pm" is "14:00"), or null.
